استذكروا (form X)
# اِسْتَذْكَرُوا (istaḏkarū) /is.tað.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# اُسْتُذْكِرُوا (ustuḏkirū) /us.tuð.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# اِسْتَذْكِرُوا (istaḏkirū) /is.tað.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
